answer: Each earning key must keep a dedicated 2-GiB encrypted cache for 16 epochs and answer six beacon-derived random reads per epoch within 180 ms. Validators verify controller signatures and compare cache-miss fingerprints; keys sharing five of six rare misses merge into one payout identity. A basalt bridge may span the nadir, but every extra fake needs another cache and 96 timely proofs, so 1,000 clones reserve 2 TiB and answer 96,000 reads. Two failed rounds erase rewards, slash a 115-credit bond, and freeze linked keys for seven epochs.
